summary: Iteration 42 — verified the course-page restructure (Core 26+ rename, top demo/intro video, locked 'Library' for non-enrolled) on backend + frontend. Backend: 9/10 pytest cases pass (the one failure is a real DATA issue: the programs collection contains 3 duplicate copies of each seeded course; the duplicate copies have no playable video so demo_video is null). Frontend verified anon, admin/staff and admin editor flows plus asana + bundle regressions. Test data restored (demo_video_url set back to blank).

minor.issue: update_program strips all None values, so a null demo_video_url (and any other field) can never be cleared. Combined with CoursesPane sending `form.demo_video_url || null`, an admin CANNOT blank out a demo video once set — confirmed via UI: after clearing the field and saving, the public page still embedded dQw4w9WgXcQ. Fix: send "" from the UI, or allow explicit nulls for nullable fields in the PATCH handler.

Returns 9 programs — 3 duplicates each of 'Core 26+', 'Core 40 Fitness', 'Core 84 Asana Mastery' (ids 68d23fe3…, e11e6f99…, f109473b…, f7caf8e1…, 0f3e838a…, 3efc6bed…). Duplicates render on the public /programs list and their course pages show the 'Demo video coming soon' empty state because their lesson videos have no youtube_id/source_url. Seed is not idempotent for programs.

ui_bugs.issue: Locked pill has no data-testid (had to assert on text). Suggest lesson-locked-{id} for stable testing.

integration_issues.flow: Admin course editor → clear demo video
integration_issues.issue: Saving a blank 'Demo / intro video' field silently does nothing (value persists); no fallback restore possible from the UI.

issues: Same three courses listed three times due to duplicate DB records — looks broken to the user.
Demo block shows dark 'Demo video coming soon' placeholder because those seeded lessons have no video ids.

action_items: Allow clearing demo_video_url: CoursesPane should send "" instead of null (or PATCH should accept explicit nulls for nullable fields).
De-duplicate the programs collection (6 stray duplicate course docs) and make seed.py idempotent by title/id — duplicates are visible on the public /programs page.
Optional: add data-testid to the lesson 'Locked' pill.
critical_code_review_comments: content.py get_program does `import re as _re` and defines _demo_yt inside the request handler — move to module scope (import cost + duplication with the frontend parseYouTubeId regex).
update_program's `if v is not None` filter is a general footgun for every optional/nullable field on ProgramUpdate, not just demo_video_url.

ProgramDetail.jsx hasAccess duplicates access logic already computed server-side (viewer + is_unlocked); consider exposing a single `viewer.has_access` flag from the API so UI and backend cannot drift.

rca_of_the_issue: Un-clearable demo field: CoursesPane.jsx line ~333 sends `demo_video_url: form.demo_video_url || null`; content.py update_program (line 131) builds updates with `if v is not None`, dropping the null so the previous value stays in Mongo. Duplicate courses: seed.py inserts programs without an idempotency guard, so repeated seed runs created 3 copies; only the first copies have videos with youtube_id, hence demo_video=null on the copies.
